words: The onboarding alone saved us two weeks. Our team actually enjoys using it.
We tried four tools before this one. This is the first that stuck.
It gets out of the way. That’s the highest compliment I can give software.
Rock solid. We moved 2 million records over a weekend without a hiccup.
Bookings that used to take an hour now take five minutes.
The API docs are the best I’ve read. Examples for everything.
Our campaigns finally live in one place. Reporting writes itself.
Paid for itself in the first month. Not exaggerating.
